about · ensemble labs

People and agents, building together.

Ensemble is the French word for "together". We build the layer that lets a company's people and its agents work from the same agreed context, so what one learns, all of them know.

Talk to usEnsemble Labs

How we think about what comes next.

The next few years put an agent next to every person at work. The question is not whether they will be capable. It is whether they will know what the company knows, and whether anyone will be able to tell what they did.

Companies run on agreed context

Not on documents. On the procedures, facts and numbers a team has actually agreed on. Most of that lives in people's heads and in threads. We write it down once and keep it right.

Agents deserve the same context as people

An agent that reads a different copy of the truth than its colleague is a liability. Every agent should read what the person it works for may read, and nothing more.

People stay in the loop

Agents propose, people approve. Every change has a name on it and a version behind it. That is how trust in agents is earned, one reviewed edit at a time.

A company brain is not a bigger search box. It is the set of things a company has agreed on, kept by people, read by everyone, including the agents.

How we work.

  1. Build with the teams that use it. Atlas is run for a small number of companies we work with directly. What ships is what a team needed last week.
  2. Prefer the boring, reliable choice. Versions, diffs, audit logs, access checks. The unglamorous parts are the ones that make context reliable.
  3. Design for people and agents at once. The same pages, the same rules, the same search, in a browser and over MCP. If it is confusing for a person, it is wrong for an agent too.

Where this goes.

A company where every person and every agent starts from the same understanding, and where what any of them learns is kept for all of them. Not a bigger model. A shared, maintained memory that people trust because they can see it and shape it.

Agents that know the company

Not a generic assistant, but one that knows how the month-end close runs here, what churn means here, and what it may not do.

People who stay in charge

Every change reviewed, every read on the record. Trust grows from evidence, one approved edit at a time.

Work that compounds

When a person fixes a page, every agent gets it. When an agent finds a gap, a person closes it. The context gets better with use.

Building this with a few teams at a time.

We work directly with the companies that use Atlas and set it up together. If that sounds like you, write to us.
